d: Long, flowing crimson hair with jagged bangs and a high-reaching crest is paired with sharp, narrow golden eyes and a youthful, mature facial expression. The build is slender and athletic, dressed in a white and gold breastplate over a short pleated red skirt, complemented by a flowing red and black cape, white and gold greaves, and black thigh-high stockings. A glowing orange flame-blade is held in one hand, while a black scabbard with gold accents hangs at the hip.
